A 5% solution in wa- ter has a pH of 3.0 to 5.0. Protect from light. Profile Histidine is a basic amino acid that is essential for infant growth and which may be essential for some other groups, such as pa- tients with uraemia. Histidine and histidine hydrochloride are used as dietary supplements.
